BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fees for health records; and adding a newsection to chapter 70.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No fee may be charged by a health care provider for reproducinghealth care information or any clerical activities associated withreproducing and delivering health care information, except as providedin this chapter. (2) No fee may be charged by a health care provider for respondingto a request for documentation for purposes of determining amounts owedby a patient and furnishing payment for those referenced charges owingby the patient to that provider.
